official.application_route: Register and apply online at https://studyin.kz/admission during the published window, then sit the online test and online interview, with grants awarded by the Selection Committee and results published on the Study in Kazakhstan portal.
official.citizenship_residency: Open to foreign citizens and individuals of Kazakh nationality who are not citizens of Kazakhstan; citizens of Kazakhstan are not the target group of this programme.
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the programme is expressly for international applicants: foreign citizens and persons of Kazakh nationality who are not citizens of Kazakhstan.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: The participating universities and the available fields of study are published on the Study In portal during the application window (the 2024 cycle list comprised 37 participating universities).
official.research_requirement: Doctoral (PhD) applicants must substantiate the topic of the dissertation research in the language of instruction (Kazakh or Russian or English).
official.duration: The application covers the full period of study of the chosen bachelor's, master's or doctoral programme; programme lengths are not stated on the programme pages.
official.description: The Scholarship Program for Studying at Universities in Kazakhstan, operated by JSC "Center for International Programs", annually awards government scholarship places (550 in the 2026 round: 490 bachelor's, 50 master's, 10 PhD) to foreign citizens, including ethnic Kazakhs who are not citizens of Kazakhstan, for study at leading higher education institutions of Kazakhstan. Applications for the full period of study are submitted online through the Study in Kazakhstan portal in Kazakh, Russian or English, followed by online testing and an online interview.
official.program_type: Government scholarship - Scholarship Program for Studying at Universities in Kazakhstan

applicant_utility.summary: This is a state-funded route into Kazakh universities for foreign citizens and ethnic Kazakhs without Kazakh citizenship, with 550 grant places split each year across bachelor's, master's and PhD study. Applications run once a year - the 2026 window was 30 March to 31 May - entirely through the Study in Kazakhstan portal, and selection combines an online test, an online interview and a final decision by the Selection Committee. Because no stipend figure or coverage statement is published on the operator's pages, treat the award as a funded study place and budget independently for living costs until you see written award terms.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Applicants outside Kazakhstan - including ethnic Kazakhs who hold another citizenship - with strong school or university records who want a degree taught in Kazakh, Russian or English at a participating Kazakh university.
application_readiness_checklist: Register at studyin.kz/admission before the window opens and enter your name exactly as in your passport, because the portal profile carries through every later stage.

Order the two medical certificates early - a health certificate for travellers to study abroad and an HIV/AIDS certificate - both issued by the official health authority of your country of residence; they are the usual long pole in the file.

Arrange notarised translations of your school or university documents into Kazakh, Russian or English, and check the thresholds: at least 'good' in secondary education for bachelor's, a 3.0/4.0 GPA or equivalent for master's and PhD.
Secure one recommendation letter for bachelor's or two for master's and PhD, from your school or employer, plus a motivational essay, all in Kazakh, Russian or English.
For master's or PhD, book an IELTS Academic (5.5+), TOEFL iBT (46+) or TOEFL PBT (453+) early unless your previous degree was taught in the programme language.

Track the Study In portal when the window opens, because the participating-university and field list only appears then, and pre-select a realistic programme and an interview language you are comfortable in.
common_rejection_risks: Applying for a level you have already studied - the operator requires each education level to be pursued for the first time.
Missing notarised translations or one of the two medical certificates, which removes the file before any interview.
Choosing a university or field that is not on the participating list published for the current window.
Falling at the online testing stage: in the 2025 round 6,529 applicants were admitted to testing but only 4,352 reached the interview stage.
A weak academic record - at least 'good' in secondary education for bachelor's, a 3.0 out of 4.0 GPA for master's and doctoral applicants.
Leaving uploads to the final hours; submissions cut off at 23:59 Astana time with no late channel described.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The official pages publish no monetary value for the grant and no statement of what it pays for, so assume you must self-fund accommodation, food, local transport, visa and medical formalities, and any university charges not covered by the grant, until written award terms say otherwise.
document_audit: The motivational essay and recommendation letters must be in Kazakh, Russian or English; files only in another language are not accepted.
The notarised translation of the previous education certificate with transcript is mandatory - a plain copy is not enough.
The traveller's health and HIV/AIDS certificates must come from the official health authority of your country of residence, not from a private clinic.
PhD applicants need a written justification of the dissertation topic in the language of instruction.
An invitation letter from a Kazakh university is optional, but the operator's wording rewards it when available.
Passport scans must match the personal data entered in the portal account, including nationality and ethnicity fields.
alerts: The 2026 round closed on 31 May 2026, and as of 10 October 2026 no next-round dates had been published - the operator's programme page still carries the 2026 round text.
The portal's grants page still shows 2024-cycle wording (a former operator name and 1 March to 1 June 2024 dates); rely on the operator's bolashak.gov.kz pages for current-cycle facts.
Selection is tight: the 2025 round ran at about 11 applicants per bachelor's place and 18 to 19 per master's or doctoral place, with a large reserve list.
Awards are decided centrally by the Selection Committee (the 2025 decision was dated 30 July) and the main and reserve lists are published on studyin.kz.
Each level of education must be pursued for the first time, so a second bachelor's or a repeat master's is out of scope.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register on studyin.kz/admission, complete the application in Kazakh, Russian or English with all uploads, then sit the online test and online interview before the Selection Committee decides, with results published on the portal.
